parrafo_1.es: The Pressure Cleaning Specialists trabaja en Port St. Lucie y la Treasure Coast. Sus clientes destacan lo mismo una y otra vez: conocimiento, precios razonables y respuesta rápida con el presupuesto.
parrafo_1.en: The Pressure Cleaning Specialists works across Port St. Lucie and the Treasure Coast. Customers point to the same things again and again: knowledgeable, reasonably priced, and quick to turn around a quote.

parrafo_2.es: Desde driveways hasta techos completos, el equipo llega con su propio camión y equipo, listo para dejar la propiedad como nueva.
parrafo_2.en: From driveways to full roof washes, the crew shows up with their own truck and equipment, ready to leave the property looking new.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesitas limpiar: driveway, techo, fachada o pool deck.
texto.en: Tell us what needs cleaning: driveway, roof, siding or pool deck.

texto.es: Respondemos con el precio en poco tiempo, sin vueltas. Varios clientes destacan lo rápido de esa respuesta.
texto.en: We respond with the price in a short time, no runaround. Several customers point to just how fast that response is.

texto.es: Llegamos con nuestro propio camión y equipo, listos para cada superficie: lavado a presión o soft wash según corresponda.
texto.en: We show up with our own truck and equipment, ready for each surface: pressure wash or soft wash as needed.

texto.es: Revisamos el resultado juntos. La mayoría de nuestros clientes nos llama de nuevo para el siguiente trabajo.
texto.en: We walk the result together. Most of our customers call us back for the next job.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según la superficie y el tamaño. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the surface and the size. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: El servicio más mencionado por nuestros clientes. Soft wash que quita las manchas sin dañar la teja.
texto.en: The service our customers mention the most. Soft wash that lifts the stains without damaging the tile.

texto.es: Fachadas libres de moho y de la humedad típica de Florida.
texto.en: Siding free of mold and the typical Florida grime.

texto.es: Pavers y concreto recuperan su color original, con el contraste a la vista.
texto.en: Pavers and concrete get their original color back, with the contrast plain to see.

texto.es: El área de la piscina limpia y sin resbalones, lista para usarse.
texto.en: The pool area clean, slip-free and ready to enjoy.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llámanos y te confirmamos si podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us and we will confirm whether we can help.

items.quote: Andrew did awesome job on cleaning my roof. He was professional and punctual. Im very happy with the job he has done. I do recommend his services and will be using moving forward.

What can I say, the services received for our house, pool deck and driveway washing was awesome! We recently moved into our new home and the outside needed cleaning desperately. So glad we met Anthony! He did an outstanding job and was quick to respond with estimate, price and completed work.

Phenomenal job done on my home, the owner and crew are great and the price is beyond affordable! If you're looking for pressure cleaning of your roof, home or driveway I couldn't recommend this company enough!

The Pressure Cleaning Specialists Team provided me with a great service at one of my properties. The team was very knowledgeable, pricing was very reasonable and provided prompt turnaround in getting the job done. Thank you Andrew and team.
My driveway and walkway was in dire need of a pressure washing, removing the old sealant, polish and reseal. Also, the house and roof needed soft washing. It's the 2nd time that I've used them.
